signature.name: The roast ladder
signature.whyOnlyThisProduct: Northwind's six coffees differ chiefly by where the drum is stopped, so the catalogue's own sorting axis is turned into four macro photographs of the bean at four points in the roast, with the coffees docked at their real rung — a control that would be meaningless on any site that does not roast its own coffee.

referenceAdoptions.principle: Hairline-ruled rows with an oversized figure hung left of its unit, so a claim can be scanned before it is read.
A proportional time axis where the width of a segment is its real duration, so a 30-second bloom cannot look the same size as a 150-second pour.

referenceAdoptions.source: Darkroom contact sheets and colour grading
referenceAdoptions.principle: Holding a set of images in one graded state and lifting only the selected frame to full colour, so selection reads as attention rather than as filtering.

referenceAdoptions.source: Contemporary agency-site scroll spectacle (pinned WebGL sequences)
referenceAdoptions.principle: Pinned, scroll-jacked hero sequences as the primary peak.

continuity.motif: The roast ink: one colour sampled from the four roast photographs, carried from the nav chip through the ledger figures, the ladder, the catalogue rack, the subscription shelf and the footer stamp.

affectedRegions.effect: The roast chip in the sticky nav, visible on every screen before the peak, takes the colour of the selected roast.
The macro photograph cross-fades to the selected roast and the readout names its drop point.
The selected roast's group opens into full-colour origin cards while the others compress to racked priced lines.
The shelf lists the bags of the selected roast, with their prices and an ink rule.

identityChannels.channel: Origin tone sampled from that coffee's own photograph

mechanisms.name: Drum drift
mechanisms.primarySubject: The roaster discharging a finished batch into the cooling tray
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: Drift is retained but the veil is bottom-weighted and the batch card leaves the image, becoming a three-column strip beneath the buttons.
mechanisms.visibleChange: The photograph scales from 1.0 to 1.14 and shifts down 8% while the veil darkens to 0.92, so the hero ends on near-black and the cut to paper lands as a cut.

mechanisms.name: Roast ladder selection
mechanisms.primarySubject: Macro photographs of Northwind's coffee at four points in the roast
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: The stage becomes 4:3 and the four rungs stay one horizontal ladder as tall tap targets with the count stacked under the label.
mechanisms.visibleChange: The stage photograph cross-fades between four distinct macro frames, the brass travel bar slides to the chosen rung, the readout swaps roast name, drop point and note, and the page ink changes colour.

mechanisms.name: Catalogue rack
mechanisms.primarySubject: The six coffees Northwind sells, with their origins, notes and prices
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: Racked rows replace the thumbnail with a roast-ink tick and the open group becomes single-column 16:10 cards; every add-to-cart button stays at 44px in both states.
mechanisms.visibleChange: The selected roast's rows change from 76px duotone lines to tall 4:5 full-colour origin cards, and the group rule and heading take the roast ink.

mechanisms.name: Brew clock scrub
mechanisms.primarySubject: The pour-over Northwind's brew guide describes, on its real 3-minute clock
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: The axis loses its sub-labels and the four steps stack full width, with unreached steps dimmed rather than hidden.
mechanisms.visibleChange: A brass fill travels the axis, the elapsed clock counts from 0:00 to 3:00, the dry hatch gives way to the bloom photograph and then the pour photograph, and each step lights as the fill passes its mark.

mechanisms.name: Subscription shelf
mechanisms.primarySubject: The bags the chosen roast would put in the monthly box
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: The shelf drops below the pitch at full width and keeps every named bag and price.
mechanisms.visibleChange: The shelf's named coffees, prices, heading and top rule change with the roast chosen at the ladder.
